# Shape kinds

Use these in `nodes[].kind`. Aliases (e.g. `postgres` → `database`) also work; unknown kinds draw as a rectangle with a *did you mean* warning.

## Generic kinds

| Kind | Category | Shape | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | terminal | terminator | Entry point of a flow (rounded terminator). |
| `end` | terminal | terminator | Exit point of a flow (rounded terminator). |
| `initial` | terminal | circle | State machine initial pseudo state (filled dot). |
| `final` | terminal | circle | State machine final pseudo state. |
| `process` | flow | rect | A step or action in a flow. |
| `subprocess` | flow | subprocess | A predefined process that is detailed elsewhere. |
| `data` | flow | parallelogram | Input or output data (parallelogram). |
| `document` | flow | document | A document or report. |
| `manual` | flow | trapezoid | A manual step done by a person. |
| `state` | flow | rounded | A state in a state machine (rounded). |
| `pipeline` | flow | rounded | A CI/CD or data pipeline. |
| `build` | flow | rounded | A build step. |
| `test` | flow | rounded | A test or verification step. |
| `deploy` | flow | rounded | A deployment or release step. |
| `decision` | decision | decision | A yes/no or branching question. |
| `service` | compute | rounded | A backend service or application component. |
| `microservice` | compute | rounded | A small independently deployable service. |
| `component` | compute | rounded | A component inside a container or application (C4 component). |
| `container` | compute | rounded | A deployable app or data container (C4 container, e.g. SPA, API, DB). |
| `system` | compute | rounded | A software system (C4 software system). |
| `worker` | compute | rounded | A background worker or job processor. |
| `function` | compute | rounded | A serverless function. |
| `cron` | compute | rounded | A scheduled job or scheduler (cron, timer). |
| `cluster` | compute | hexagon | A container orchestration cluster such as Kubernetes. |
| `ml-model` | compute | hexagon | A machine-learning model or inference endpoint. |
| `llm` | compute | hexagon | A large language model or AI assistant. |
| `api` | integration | hexagon | An API or web service endpoint. |
| `gateway` | integration | hexagon | An API gateway or protocol gateway. |
| `queue` | integration | queue | A message queue or broker. |
| `topic` | integration | queue | A pub/sub topic or event stream (Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis). |
| `etl` | integration | hexagon | An ETL / data integration job or pipeline. |
| `email` | integration | rounded | An email service (SMTP, transactional mail). |
| `notification` | integration | rounded | A notification or push service (SMS, push, chat alerts). |
| `database` | data | cylinder | A database or data store (cylinder). |
| `cache` | data | cylinder | An in-memory cache such as Redis or Memcached. |
| `storage` | data | cylinder | Object, blob or file storage. |
| `data-warehouse` | data | cylinder | An analytical data warehouse. |
| `data-lake` | data | cylinder | A data lake for raw and curated data. |
| `search` | data | cylinder | A search index or engine (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch). |
| `vector-db` | data | cylinder | A vector database for embeddings. |
| `repo` | data | rounded | A source code (git) repository. |
| `registry` | data | rounded | A container or package registry. |
| `artifact` | data | rounded | A build artifact or package. |
| `webapp` | client | rounded | A web app, website or frontend page. |
| `client` | client | icon | A client application or browser. |
| `mobile` | client | icon | A mobile device or app. |
| `pc` | client | icon | A desktop or laptop computer. |
| `user` | person | person | A person or actor using the system. |
| `person` | person | person | A person (C4 person). |
| `actor` | person | person | An actor interacting with the system (UML actor). |
| `external` | external | rect | An external system or third-party service outside your control. |
| `external-system` | external | rect | An external software system (C4 external system). |
| `payment` | external | rounded | A payment provider or gateway (Stripe, PayPal). |
| `server` | network | icon | A generic server. |
| `router` | network | icon | A network router. |
| `switch` | network | icon | A network switch. |
| `loadbalancer` | network | hexagon | A load balancer spreading traffic across instances. |
| `cdn` | network | hexagon | A content delivery network. |
| `dns` | network | hexagon | A DNS service or zone. |
| `cloud` | network | cloud | A cloud or WAN network region. |
| `internet` | network | cloud | The public internet. |
| `firewall` | security | icon | A firewall. |
| `waf` | security | hexagon | A web application firewall. |
| `vpn` | security | hexagon | A VPN gateway or tunnel. |
| `identity` | security | rounded | An identity provider (IdP, SSO, directory). |
| `secrets` | security | rounded | A secrets manager or key vault. |
| `monitoring` | generic | rounded | Monitoring, metrics and alerting. |
| `logging` | generic | rounded | Log collection and analysis. |
| `box` | generic | rect | A plain rectangle. |
| `ellipse` | generic | ellipse | A plain ellipse. |
| `mindmap-root` | generic | ellipse | The central topic of a mind map. |
| `executive` | org | rect | A top executive in an org chart. |
| `manager` | org | rect | A manager in an org chart. |
| `position` | org | rect | An employee or position in an org chart. |
| `entity` | entity | entity | A database entity (table) in an ER diagram. |
| `note` | note | note | A sticky note or free text annotation. |
